summary: Dentistry on 66 has a clean layout, a working request form and 30 years of experience. Thin proof and a few leftover details hold back a clinic that promotes veneers and smile makeovers.

findings.problem: No before and after gallery appears, even though the page promotes veneers, whitening and smile makeovers. Only three short reviews show, with no dates or ratings.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients decide on visible results. Without them, price becomes the deciding factor and you lose to the cheapest clinic.
findings.fix: A captioned before and after gallery and dated reviews linked to your Google profile.

findings.problem: The heading Why patients choose ourDentistry on 66 has a missing space, and a stray 66 fragment shows in the hero.
findings.cost: Visible errors in headings make a long established practice look careless to a new patient.
findings.fix: A proofread build with clean, consistent headings.

findings.problem: The page says same day emergency appointments are available, but the clinic is closed Friday to Sunday, and there is no after hours option.
findings.cost: A patient in pain on a closed day finds no clear path and calls another clinic.
findings.fix: A clear after hours path, real booking and a WhatsApp or chat option.

findings.problem: The services grid and Comprehensive Dental Care sections repeat, the clinic exterior photo appears three times, and the same resource card text repeats under every card.
findings.cost: Repeated sections and images push real content down and weaken your search ranking.
findings.fix: One clean version of every section and treatment pages that answer what patients search for.

redesign: A proof first homepage with real before and after cases, dated reviews and your credentials beside every booking button.
A booking form, a clear after hours option and WhatsApp.
